items.text: Geamwaal gichea eenuusta Yesu
Iidu nea ghoahiit Yesu ng'asheesu seaniin gwayeesha giinealangaaschi,
“Moanali gideaba iing'ata eawooji iyeenya abeeda gajea ghweelmeeda Basaaka gil, ak gajeatayda Orjeeda Siida eengoor.”
Aba damandida gabassa geat Ashoohoodiga hees ea gweargwa seamooda gheeh Gayafa nea ashoohoocheanda haw gil.
Gabaloola gichea ghoang'waayda Yesu aba seachta ak geenuus.
Iidu gwaneaji gideaba “Adeesinyi ng'asheanji eaweeda ghweelmeeda aba gideaba gajiidu ghwadaakghuyan eemeeda.”
Yesu geayeasha nagheeda aba Betaniya
Damanda mideewa Yesu gheeh Simoneeda siguura siida bearji udamusuura,

ghwahidu headaanyi gatmooni eatu gideeshteayda nyiit nagheeda ng'andit guuyi sakghwiilo biissa gaba sheayeeda haw, ghwahidu nea goobiitpiit gheata agiischooda, ak goodalealsa uhuuda nagheedida ng'andidiin.
Daah giinealanga ng'asheanji gwanyareesi, nea gwayi, “Darariini gaba naaha?
Nagheani gwachi iisishaayda gayghwanyas lapiyeeda saang'a jea eataw fuga barbari.”
Gwajeeng'u Yesu gidabaloola jeesinga nyaawa ak gwayeesha, “Ghwasaan anda gooteawiichi gatmooda? Niny gwasinnean ng'asheanda miy.
Aba gideaba fuga barbari goondeaydooscheewi galeagasean, amaduuku aniini ea majeendeayeena galeagasean.
Gatmooni goodalealsean nagheeda ng'andit aba gideaba gwasisinan aba bunyiteanyu.
Aba huumwa geayeeshiineegwa, heeda wassean aba muunda ng'eanyiida sirukwiideaysa Giijasi Miyiin, gili sin gatmooniin, gajeebaloola aba giipkeataanyi.”
Yuda ghamwas ghwala bwadaw Yesu
Muchu gawa Yudayda Iskariyote nea gaba jeedeaba giinealangiga atamaniyeenyean heeda ashoohoodiga hees.
Hita gwayeesha, “Gajagoonean naaha iyaalaapchi bwadaw niny ak geagoonyeegwa?” Geeyiitiisa geatinga shiliingaji diktam ea damanamughuush.
Ghang'eada damandida gagaseadayi gheata gichea ghwalaapta bwadaw.
Yesu ghwaak hamita Basaaka sea ginealangaaschi
Eaweeda madeeda nea miighwahidu ghweelmeeda mukaatajeega miigamatawiidi, gaweay giinealanga heeda Yesu ak gwayeesha, “Gigasayi eesineey hamita Basaaka aba yeenu?”
Gwayeesha niny, “Aweayeena mujiini gheapa sih ak gooyeeshi, ‘Gwayi Giinealshoocheanda, nigul damandeanyu ak geagasayi daak hamita Basaaka sea giinealangeasu aba jeedeaba gheang'u.’”
Gwasinda giinealanga ng'asheega gidarukusiinda Yesu ak ghoang'eat sinooda Basaaka.
Was shing'ada goopteada Yesu sea giinealangaaschi atamaniyeenya nea gweagiischi.
Damani agiischeewean, gwayeesha, “Aba huumwa, geayeeshiineegwa, siyagi aba jeedeang'wa gayghwalaabwan bwadaw.”
Gagiisan giinealanga muuchi, ak gaba siisi anyaashta nea gwayeesha, “Siida aniini Ng'utamiida?”
Ghwasha nea gwayeesha, “Siida jea dang'uta buurda sea niny nih siida jea ghwalaabwan bwadaw gil.
Orjeeda siida gaygawa, gawuurji gidaghayi sing'oorsiinda, amadu ea dashageada siidida jea ghwala bwadaw Orjeeda Siidean! Siisi ghang'wana gwachi ea meeji.”
Gwayeesha Yudayda jea ghwala bwadaw, “Rabi, aniini ghanea?” Gwayeesha niny, “Girgu ang'iing'i.”
Hamita Ng'utamiida
Damanda agiischooda gageanu Yesu mukaate ak gang'usha, ak ghabwanach, ak ghoadaw giinealangaaschi nea gwayeesha, “Oang'waanya ak ghoayaaji, nih saseedeanyu gil.”
Ng'ata gageanu gikoombe, ak gabadiischeesa, ak ghoadaw nea gwayeesha, “Aleayda bayoogi oogasean.
Aba gideaba suh foojeandeanyu bea neajeeda gil, ak geahiida aba badahuuka fuga saang'a aba geandeayda riing'eeda.
Gaydayeeshiineegwa maygudu dabiikta dali gicha difaayeeda sabiibu ea eaghus dabiikta dali gicha gea eashish sea agooga aba jeeda sugoocheanduumeeda Bwaabwa.”
Iing'ata sarmeeda duumda, ghang'eatng'eat gaweay uhuuda giijeeda saytuunajeega.
Yesu gabean gwarugu sheang'da Betaro
Gwayeesha Yesu saawa, “Eaweani bea ghamneawean gajastaan oogasean aba gideaba geang'waar, ‘Gaydabwar jeagiischoocheanda, ak gayghwadarda hawanda gisilga.’
Iimuchu nea ghang'ata duunoodeanyu gaydeasheedeawaneegwa dawa Galilaya.”
Ghwasha Betaro nea gwayeesha niny, “Eara ghamwachmwachnyi buuneeda ak gwanung'useey heeda, aniini maydanung'useey heeda earahay.”
Gwayeesha Yesu niny, “Aba huumwa geayeeshiineey eaweani bea ghamneawean heeda mii googuuleewa nghaghooda, gajea nishaang'nyaan niba samwagu.”
Gwayeesha Betaro, “Eara ghoah miyeeda eemeewdeayeena maydashaang'nyi earahay.” Ghwanyaashtunu giinealanga sean.
Yesu ghamwaash ASEETA aba Getsemani
Iidu goodeayi Yesu ea saawa jeeda madamnyeanda mwanang' siguura Getsemani, ama ng'ata gwayeesha giinealangaaschi, “Oopiitpiida aba hiji dawa hoowa damwaash ASEETA.”
Ghwaat Betaro sea orju iyeenya bea Sebedayo, ak ghang'ut giiseaneega ea gwadeawiit.
Miighoah gil gwayeesha, “Guroroodeanyu ea giisaneat muuchi ea ghwariikghta dami, Oopiitpiida aba hiji nea ghoang'wearu sea aniini.”

Hean gawa mwadi gilimwanang' ak gwatkuy ak gakula gheamamdaanyi ng'eanyi ak ghamwaash ASEETA nea, gwayi, “Ea Bwaabwa, iimuusi ginung' ghwasajaadawanaan bayoogi, ea adaghoah gida eagasiidi aniini, nung' ghoah gidigasiidi ang'iing'i.”
Ghang'eat gawa heeda giinealanga ak ghwahita nea nilil. Gwayeesha Betaro, “Heapi miimuusi gideaba gajang'wearni eara jeemba aseedeanagi eesa aniini?
Oang'wearni nea ghoamwaashchi ASEETA ea moapiitani jeeda simsimda; guroorooda ghwanyawa gagasa, amadu ea ng'arng'ar saseeda.”
Gabiikta deabiyeenya ak ghamwaash ASEETA nea gwayi, “Ea Bwaabwa, iimay ghwasajaadawanaan bayoogi ea eeghus daleayda nung'waada gwasa gidigasiidi ang'iing'i.”
Gabiikta gicha heeda giinealanga ak ghwahita nea nilil aba gideaba nidurmaniidi gheanyanga nyaawa aba ruweanga.
Gabiikta gwanung'usa heeda ak gawa ghamwaash ASEETA deaba samwagu nea gwarugu ng'asheega gwachi.
Ng'ata gabiigu heeda giinealangaaschi ak gwayeesha, “Abisiina alila nea goofuufchi? Adaaha nihidu damanda ak Orjeeda Siida gajeayiin geatinga fuga riing'eega.
Ang'eatng'eada, eeweaya; oang'wearda siida jea ghwalaabwan bwadaw nukwa nineekiit.”
Ging'ooyda Yesu

Damanda duu gwandeawa hoowa nea gabalool ghwahidu Yuda nea gaba jeedeaba giinealangiga atamaniyeenyean, nea goodeanyi sea eemeeda mideawa ng'utkeaka ea gulupkeaka nea goojeagu ashoohoodiga hees ea gweargwa.
Iidu siidida jea ghwala bwadaw Yesuun abeeda ea nigeawiit ghoadaw gwadeagooda nea gwayeesha, “Siidida jea dasamiin ajeeng'ni gideaba niny gil, abeeda ghoang'waanyi.”
Hean gwaneekiisa Yuda Yesu ak gwayeesha, “Seayu Siida haw!” Amwahit ghwasam.
Gwayeesha Yesu niny, “Ea orjeeda siida eaduupcheewi, ghwasaan anda gindi hiji?” Ng'ata ghwahidu fugiga ak ghoang'waay Yesu.
Gageanu orjeanagi aba jeedeaba orjoogiga gwachi mideawa Yesuun, ak ghoahaakta geadi ak gafagu ng'utaanyi, ak ghwalas soomjeandida bea ashoohoocheanda hawiin, ak ghwalach iita.
Gwayeesha Yesu niny, “Adealda ng'utaang'u jeeda labaldaanyi, aba gideaba siida bwarda ng'uta, eara niny gajeabwara ng'uta.
Moanali gideaba gwachi ghaamuuschi damus Bwaabwa ea mii ghoah gil gaygoojeagu lugooda saang'a bea malaykajeega?
Abeeda gaygwasamwataan Ng'ooruutka ayi nih gidamiisa ghoawda baloolda gil?”

Damandida gwayeesha Yesu eemeeda, “Asi agooga ghoapkaanyi oang'waanyaan nea gooyeadu ng'utkeaka ea gulupkeaka ghoanung' dawuurji mareanghweanda? Eawoojisu geabiiti gheeda sibata ASEETA nea geanealshi ak ea moong'oanyean!
Ghamneawa ea nisa ng'asheesu seaniin gwasa Ng'ooruutka ghayi bea sibaneeda.” Iidu gwanung'usa heeda giinealanga ak gwasalda.
Yesu aba madeeda girgweageeda
Hean gageanu fuga gwachi ang'waay Yesu ak ghwaat gheeh Gayafeeda was ashoohoocheanda haw, nea nibatiisa geat ng'oorshoodiga ea gweargwa.
Ghwaat geeshta Betaro nea gameaji ea sheagi ea ghwahita seamooda gheeda ashoohoocheanda haw, gaweay jeeda gheeda nea goodeayi furiischoodiga nea gagasa ghwadaah gichea eesin.
Hean gagasa Ashoohoodiga hees ea gweargwa sean bea gheeda girgweageeda ng'asheanda ng'uyyeega jea eemuuwu aba badayda Yesu jea iidu eenuuksa,
iidu ea mudu ghwanyas ng'asheanda jea eenoas earapeadi buwa mushoodiga saang'a bea ng'uyyeega. Hean iidu aba huuydeanda ghwahidu fih iyeenya
ak gwayeesha, “Siisi ghayi gwayi, ‘Ghaamuuschi danyarja gheawi Sibata ASEETEAN ak geabiikti dadeas gicha aba askwearjooji samwagu.’”
Ghang'eat Ashoohoocheanda haw ak ghoanyaash, “Heapi mwayshaaha eara ng'ashaan? Fiisu gamuuwu naaha aba badaydaang'u?”
Ghwasiinda Yesu. Gwayeesha Ashoohoocheanda haw, “Eaniyean aksiina ASEETA majeek habeawooda rukuneasa ang'iing'i ea guwoosi Gristo, Orjeeda ASEETA.”

Gwayeesha Yesu niny, “Girgu ang'iing'i. Asi gaydayeeshiineegwa, ghang'eada ghamneawa gajadaaha Orjeeda Siida nea goopteada aba meatkweeda geatinda dugwa hoauur, nea ghoana badayda shamooghuutka humng'eeda.”
Aba damani ghabwaashaada ashoohoocheanda haw hang'weakaaschi ak gwayi, “Niing'eawi ASEETA. Gudeegassa mushooduspwa naaha gicha? Asi ghamneawa nukwa siyiinyi giing'weakaaschi.
Gooyeenyiin agooga aba girgweageedeang'wa?” Ghwasha saawa nea gwayeesha, “Gammiisa gideaba gajeenuus.”
Hean geeng'uriisa ng'usheega gheamamdaanyi, nea geabwar diigeanga; nea suurja gagul,
nea gwayeesha, “Ea Gristo! heapi daaha ea jea nala siida lasnyi?”
Betaro ghwashaang' Yesu
Aba damandida Betaro goopteada aba seamooda. Hean gaweesa hudagi bea gadiyeeda ak gwayeesha, “Eara ang'iing'i gindeaydooscheewi Yesuheeda Galilaya.”
Ghwashaang' Betaro aba madeeda buuneeda nea gwayeesha, “Aniini mwaanali eara gidirgu.”
Iidu nea gwariteawa gidaghuuta gabiikta ghwadaah hut nuut bea gadiyeeda ak gwayeesha, fuga ghwanyawa mida hoowa, “Siisi gwachi gwandeayi sea Yesuheeda Nasareti.”
Gabiikta ghwashaang' Betaro nea ghwaak habeawooda nea gwayeesha, “Aniini siisi mwaanali.”
Ng'ata gheadi nuwaas gaweay fuga gwachi mida hoowa heeda Betaro ak gwayeesha, “Aba huumwa eara ang'iing'i guwoosi siyagi aba jeedeaba fugiga aba gideaba ghoahiimu baloaldaang'u.”
Damani ghamwaashta geaw Betaro nea ghwaak habeawooda nea gwayeesha, “Aniini siisi mwaanali.” Deagheata googuul nghaghooda.
Hean ghoapkaat Betaro ng'asheega heeta rukusa Yesu, bea gideaba, “Damanda miigooguula nghaghooda gajea nishaang'nyaan niba samwagu.” Gwarita jarooda ak gooyeawda.
